414:t_031:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can! That's what these wings are for!!」

414:t_031:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「My wings are wings for protecting what matters most to me!!」

414:t_033:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's all right. $$ブレラ$$ would never just stand frozen on a battlefield.」

414:t_033:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「The moment I shot him down, he came back to his senses.」

414:t_033:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「So it seems. A transmission has come in from $$ブレラ$$ requesting retrieval.」

414:t_034:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「...Understood. We will follow your guidance.」

414:t_035:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That Striker thing... is it going to join the $$ギャラクシー船団$$?!」

414:t_035:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$. Mr. $$フランジ$$ reports that the battle in the $$霧の海$$ has also come to an end.」

414:t_035:3.en:
$$ラム$$
「Having heard of Striker's retreat, those who were still resisting have reportedly surrendered too.」

414:t_035:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Those who lost their god... I hope they can decide how to live for themselves...」

414:t_035:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Striker has left this unit's detection range.」

414:t_035:6.en:
$$レド$$
「There's no need to pursue, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. Striker is not the only enemy we have to fight.」

414:t_035:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit will follow Ensign $$レド$$'s judgment.」

414:t_036:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you sure about a failed soldier like me?」

414:t_036:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「According to Striker, this unit was also judged unsuitable as a support enlightenment system.」

414:t_036:2.en:
$$レド$$
「But I have no intention of giving up fighting.」

414:t_036:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Until I find what I truly ought to do, I'll fight as a member of $c.」

414:t_036:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit's mission from here on remains support of Ensign $$レド$$.」

414:t_036:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit expects the Ensign to achieve greater results.」

414:t_036:6.en:
$$レド$$
「I can't do that on my own yet. I'll rely on you a little more, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

414:t_036:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Ensign $$レド$$'s survival is this unit's reason for existing.」

414:t_037:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm back, $$エイミー$$. I'm back, $c...」

414:t_038:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Do not interfere, pirate. After I purge Ensign $$レド$$, I will punish you.」

414:t_039:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「This is as far as it goes. $$アンタレス$$ 1, withdrawing.」

414:t_040:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「For $$ランカ$$'s sake too, I'll stop you!」

414:t_040:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Do you think someone like you can do it?」

414:t_040:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can! That's what these wings are for!!」

414:t_040:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「My wings are wings for protecting what matters most to me!!」

414:t_041:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Remember, $$ブレラ$$! Remember what matters most to you!」

414:t_041:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you going to lose to that $$インプラント$$ and make the person most precious to you cry again?!」

414:t_041:5.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I can't just stand by and watch this!!」

414:t_042:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Is he in pain from hearing $$バサラ$$'s song...?!」

414:t_042:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's not it! Most likely the fold waves from $$バサラ$$'s song are affecting $$ブレラ$$'s control system!」

414:t_042:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Come on, $$ランカ$$! You too, $$シェリル$$!」

414:t_043:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Ugh... aah...! My head... no, my chest... is burning up!」

414:t_043:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Set your heart on fire! That's the real you!!」

414:t_043:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's $$ランカ$$'s song! It's the feelings of the person most precious to you!!」

414:t_044:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Looks like you've gotten yourself back, $$ブレラ$$.」

414:t_044:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I see. I was being controlled by them again...」

414:t_044:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you're fine now. $$ランカ$$ and the others' song broke the curse on you.」

414:t_044:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Between the influence of the fold waves and $$ブレラ$$'s own resistance, the system was probably destroyed completely.」

414:t_045:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I've caused you trouble again, $$アルト$$.」

414:t_045:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it. More importantly, say something to $$ランカ$$, who's waiting for you.」

414:t_045:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ランカ$$. And thank you.」

414:t_045:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'll fight them too. Of my own will.」

414:t_046:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「A soldier's happiness lies in following orders and achieving results in battle. Nothing else is necessary.」

414:t_046:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That is how the $$人類銀河同盟$$ forced every human being to live as a soldier!」

414:t_046:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「That is the best choice for society and for the individual alike.」

414:t_046:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You're wrong, Striker or whatever you are.」

414:t_046:4.en:
$$レド$$
「We're human before we're soldiers...! No one has the right to take that way of life from us!」

414:t_046:5.en:
$$レド$$
「Even if it's a being called a god!」

414:t_100:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Securing a tactical advantage is difficult. Hit-and-run tactics recommended. Concentrate attacks on the enemy unit's head.」
